name: @wizeworks/funnels
description: Marketing funnels (docs/151) — the binding and measurement entity for a campaign whose parts already exist. Owns nothing it can borrow: goals evaluate through @wizeworks/automation-schemas' evaluator so there is one condition language in the platform, and follow-up runs through Automation and EmailSequence as they already are. Backend-safe (deps: @wizeworks/db + the schema packages, no render/React) so the event-worker can run the nightly reconcile. The client-safe ./schemas subpath is what the workbench editor imports.
